payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Assess the image as a whole and cite visible evidence for the chosen status. Complete: it reads as a chalk drawing, with the image rendered as drawn rather than remaining recognizably photographic with only chalk-like grain, smudging, or softened outlines. Partial: visible drawing-like chalk treatment has progressed, but the image remains a mixed or incomplete transformation, such as substantial photographic detail or rendering alongside chalk-like effects. Absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. Unknown: evidence is insufficient. Do not require any particular chalk technique, scene-wide uniformity, or preservation of the original content; unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
